Themes

Colours, and a woven texture in the textured tier. Layout, sizes and words never change. Try any theme on this page, or open Details to see it on the website, the computer and the phone.

    Free palette

      sets

      A theme, a banner, a frame and a fourth piece that belong together, for 80% of the parts you do not own yet.

        Banners

        A strip across the top of your profile and your account page. No text, no links.

          Frames

          A ring around your picture on your profile, the leaderboard and your stories.

            names

            Your display name in a colour of its own on your profile, the leaderboard and members. Still readable in light and dark.

              Badges

              A small mark beside your name. Looks only: it never changes your rank. Supporter badges are earned by topping up, never sold.
